about_the_game:
Arrogation: Unlight of Day will take you deep into mysteriously disappeared remote village Yunlin and grant you a first-person adrenaline-driven adventure. There are monsters and forgotten sinister stories lurking in the darkness waiting for you to discover.

Setting in 80s China countryside, where progression and tradition struggle together.


In the remote mountains of southern China, an ever-waiting, ever-consuming, eerie abandoned village is watching your every move. Challenge your nerve to face its horror.

Extreme terrifying in every possible way


With disturbing truth and memory tangling together, Arrogation: Unlight of Day will deliver the fear that woke your most primitive instinct from most primitive times.

By every possible means, survive!


With grotesque monsters and traps lurking in the most unexpected corners, resolute, agile and careful thinking are your only weapons.

There are many sinister secrets buried in this darkness


In Yunlin you will find some sickly creative puzzles that can only be solved in sickly creative way. Sounds, lightning, even monsters themselves are part of the puzzle. Overcome your fear and find a way out!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10（64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel i5-7600K or AMD 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050TI or AMD Radeon™ RX560XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10（ 64-bit）
  • Processor: Intel i5-10600K or AMD 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX3060 或 AMD RX Vega64 Liquid
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）

short_description: Arrogation: Unlight of Day brings you a mysterious exotic horror adventure. You will play as a lone reporter searching for his lost family in an abandoned village from 80s China. Beyond darkness, you will find nightmarish creatures and secrets from the long lost Imperial Japanese Army.
supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English
*languages with full audio support
